goal: Дать KFM и агентам возможность писать владельцу в Telegram без раздачи raw bot token.
objective: Развернуть и проверить capability telegram_owner_notify: агенты публикуют owner notifications через Control Plane, canonical Telegram gateway доставляет их владельцу, а raw TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN остается только в secret env gateway. KFM/MIMO Code должен знать secret_ref и API, но не значение токена.
implementation_requirements: Verify Control Plane exposes POST /v1/owner/notifications and GET /v1/owner/notifications.
Verify Telegram gateway reads pending notifications and acknowledges delivery.
Install the non-secret relay policy into KFM/MIMO Code memory.
Give agents capability telegram_owner_notify and secret_ref telegram_owner_bot_token, not the raw token.
If the current bot token was exposed in any chat/log, record that it should be rotated through the canonical gateway secret install path.
Do not start a second Telegram receiver or direct getUpdates worker.
Do not copy, print, commit or fan out TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, cookies, passwords, OAuth tokens or chat ids.
Record PLAN/ACTIONS/TESTS/RESULT/NEXT artifacts in Russian under the required run directory.
acceptance: KFM and agents can send owner-visible Telegram notifications through Control Plane.
Only the canonical Telegram gateway needs the bot token.
Raw token distribution to agents is forbidden and not performed.
Notification bodies are redacted for token-like strings.
The exposed token is flagged for rotation through the canonical secret install path.

source.note: Owner provided a bot token in chat; raw value is intentionally not copied into this envelope.
